node.statement: ℓ¹ scaling of transverse displacement. By 1.2 every row of P lies in the mass-one hyperplane with negative mass ≤ t, so for any two row-points ||p_Q - p_v||_1 ≤ (1+2·nu_Q) + (1+2·nu_v) ≤ 2 + 4t. Since p_Q - p_v = x_Q·D + y_Q·E with ||D||_1 = tau, each unit of the D-coordinate carries exactly ||x_Q·D||_1 = |x_Q|·tau of ℓ¹ transverse length; hence one unit of transverse moment costs tau of ℓ¹-length, while the whole row has bounded ℓ¹ extent 2+4t = O(1).
